subject: CAIQ evidence: gated CI approvals, secrets access, and change-control ledger export
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@assessor.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: SOC2 Reviewer <soc2-reviewer@brightaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: CI gating, change-control export, and ephemeral secrets artefacts

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As part of the CAIQ assessment for FinTrust we need a small set of artifacts to substantiate a few control assertions around your build and change pipeline. Specifically we are requesting:

- A sampling of CI job logs demonstrating successful gating (pass/fail + approver).
- An export of your change-control ledger for the date range 2027-05-01 to 2027-06-09 (commits that moved through the merge gate).
- Evidence that ephemeral secrets are used for CI jobs (audit entries or short lived credential creation events).
- A short explanation of your code-review sampling methodology (how PRs are chosen for audit sampling).

If you can provide the files as attachments or place them in a shared Drive with links and let me know the retention window for the logs, that would be ideal. Also let us know if any of the items are restricted (e.g., redacted PII) so we can note scope limitations.

Deadline: Can you provide these artifacts by EOD Monday 2027-06-14? If not, a reasonable partial delivery is fine — indicate what will be delayed.

Best,
Elena
Elena Cruz
Senior Assessor | Assessor.io

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@assessor.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: CI gating, change-control export, and ephemeral secrets artefacts

Elena —

Thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa and Jonas to pull the exports and logs. Quick notes before we collect:

- We can export a merge-gate CSV summary covering commits and the approver metadata.
- CI logs: we'll include the GitHub Actions job traces for a stratified sample (two release branches, three hotfix PRs).
- Ephemeral secrets: we will provide the KMS/HSM issuance audit snippets and the ephemeral token creation events from our CI credential broker (redacted token values).
- Sampling methodology: Marissa will attach a short write-up; it's stratified by risk score + recent deploy frequency.

We’ll stage everything in a Drive folder and attach the small, non-sensitive extracts to email. If we need to provide redacted diffs, let us know.

Alex
Alex Martinez
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CAIQ follow-up: CI gating, change-control export, and ephemeral secrets artefacts

Alex / Jonas — forwarding Elena's ask; I'm attaching the extracts below and a short sampling note. Tasks:

- Jonas: please pull the merge-gate ledger export for 2027-05-01 -> 2027-06-09 and confirm columns include commit_hash, pr_id, approver_email, approval_time, gate_outcome. Export filename: merge_gate_export_202705-202706.csv
- Jonas: attach CI job logs for these runs: release/v1.8: PR#4123, PR#4140; hotfix: PR#4210. Keep the full job trace but redact any API keys. Filename: ci_job_log_gh-actions-20270609.txt
- I’ll prepare the ephemeral secrets audit snippet from our credential broker (secrets-access-audit-snippet.txt) showing create/delete timestamps and principal ids.

Sampling note (attached): stratified sample logic: prioritize PRs touching runtime, cryptography, or secret-handling directories; include any PRs with high-risk labels in last 60 days; include a minimum of one hotfix.

ETA for attachments: I'll upload to Drive and attach the three small extracts to the culminated email by 15:00 PT.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@assessor.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, SOC2 Reviewer <soc2-reviewer@brightaudit.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: CAIQ artifacts (gated CI, merge-gate ledger, ephemeral secrets snippet)

Elena —

Attached are the requested extracts and links. Summary of contents below. Let me know if you need full unredacted logs (we can arrange a secure viewer session).

Attachments included:
- ci_job_log_gh-actions-20270609.txt (text/plain) — job traces for PR#4123, PR#4140, PR#4210. Redacted environment variables and API keys; timestamps and step-level exit codes preserved.
- merge_gate_export_202705-202706.csv (text/csv) — ledger export with columns: commit_hash, pr_id, author_email, approver_email, approval_time, gate_outcome, rollout_tag. Sample contains 112 rows for the date range.
- secrets-access-audit-snippet.txt (text/plain) — shows ephemeral token issuance events from credential-broker v2.3.2 (no token values), principal ids, creation and revocation timestamps, and KMS wrapping events.

Links:
- Drive folder (full set, access-limited): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink-CAIQ-evidence
- HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/FT-8743 (internal tracker)

Scope notes / caveats:
- Any logs containing customer-identifying data have been redacted per our privacy policy.
- Merge gate export includes automated system approvals for emergency patches; we flagged those rows in the CSV (emergency=true).
- Retention: CI job traces kept for 180 days; merge-gate ledger retained indefinitely in our configuration DB (exported CSV is a snapshot).

If this meets your needs we can mark this item closed in the CAIQ checklist. If you require additional context (e.g., pipeline definitions or policy docs), we can provide the pipeline YAMLs under an NDA or via a secure share.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: merge_gate_export_202705-202706.csv (text/csv)]
